module.privacyCopy:
C-LEAD stores classroom account, academic, attendance and contribution information for Section C coordination. Only authorized officers may access sensitive class records. Your classmates cannot view your individual attendance or payment status.

Audit records are retained indefinitely. At academic-year end, academic records are archived and accounts are retained. Leaving students are deactivated and history is preserved.

No third-party behavioral analytics or screenshot reports are collected. Push notifications are optional. Contact your class officers about corrections and privacy concerns. The institution must name its data controller, contact channel and legal basis before launch.
module.communityCopy:
Be respectful and inclusive. Keep classroom discussions relevant. Do not share private information about classmates.

Student discussions require officer approval. Report harmful content for review. Moderation decisions must include a reason and are audited.

Use your own account. Never share passwords or impersonate a classmate.

admin.title: Account administration
admin.invalid: Enter a name, a unique username of 3–40 lowercase letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens, and a student number of 3–40 characters.
admin.passwordHelp: New accounts use the student number as their temporary password. Changing a student number does not automatically change the password.
admin.error: Operation failed. Check permissions, duplicate identities, the 50-account capacity or a pending credential operation. Wait two minutes if an operation was interrupted, then retry. Account creation retries must retain the original fields.
admin.success: Operation completed. Review individual import results below.
admin.importHelp: CSV or XLSX, up to 50 rows and 2 MB. Exact headers: full_name,username,student_number. Store all cells as text to preserve leading zeros. Review every row before confirming. Only valid rows are imported, sequentially.
admin.pendingHelp: Retry these saved operations without creating duplicate accounts.
admin.editConfirm: Save these official account changes? Role or username changes sign the account out. Deactivation revokes all sessions.
admin.createConfirm: Create this student account with the student number as its temporary password?
admin.resetConfirm: Reset the password to the current student number and revoke every session? This also resolves an interrupted password change.
admin.importConfirm: Create the valid preview rows? Invalid rows are skipped. Each successful row is audited.
admin.revokeConfirm: Sign this account out on every device? The account can sign in again.
